standard.summary: 训练完成后计算 FID / CLIP Score / LPIPS（默认关闭）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Computes FID / CLIP Score / LPIPS after training finishes (off by default).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练完成后计算 FID / CLIP Score / LPIPS（默认关闭）。与训练中预览图无关。

advanced_en.principle: Computes FID / CLIP Score / LPIPS after training completes (off by default). Unrelated to in-training preview images.
